headline: Fire crew unstuck: a pillar was freezing the whole building
lede: Nightly caught the arcade's watch autopilot standing motionless mid-alarm — not a flaky test, but a real soft-lock: the ladder truck parked under a structural pillar, sealing the loft, so five victims sat unreachable while the crew stared at a wall. Fixed, with a seed-level regression gate.

notes.text: Root cause: the loft ladder gate checked only whether the deck row was open at a column — not the ground below it. Seed 1 offered the truck a pillar line; the crossing law only admits the ladder column; every rescue path returned null. 2 of 8 probe seeds could soft-lock the same way.

The gate was pinning the bug: firecrewcheck had celebrated seed 1 as an 'honorable loss' at 3/6 rescued — that was the freeze. Post-fix the autopilot finishes seed 1 6/6, and a new sweep refuses any shift that goes 1600 ticks without resolving a victim.

Also parked and merge-ready when the freeze lifts: VIPER PIT select cards get five real poses, per-fighter camera framing and hover/tap portrait zoom — plus the fix under it (all five cards had been compositing the SAME portrait since #1106).
Freeze watch: main went green on Papers-Min overnight, then one fire-crew resume gate held the whole fleet; the fix (PR #2181) carries the nightly repro green at --throttle 32.
